caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with ornate decorative features, shown against a plain light beige background. The cabinet has two main sections: the upper section features three compartments with doors, each door adorned with geometric patterns consisting of squares, rectangles, and diamond shapes in various shades of brown and tan, with vertical black spindle-like accents in between the doors and at the corners. The lower section consists of three wide horizontal drawers, each drawer front covered in an intricate scrolling vine motif in dark brown against a light tan background, with narrow vertical decorative elements separating each drawer into two panels. The top and bottom edges of the cabinet, as well as the dividing line between the upper and lower sections, feature molded trim with additional small ornamental designs. The cabinet stands on four short block feet with visible wood grain. The overall color palette includes shades of tan, brown, and black, with the details rendered meticulously to show texture and pattern. The drawing is centered on the page with ample blank space around it. At the bottom of the image, there is a signature and a number written in small script.
title: Cupboard with Drawers
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
